issues.description: The script creates a custom overlay UI and collects user input (access code) via an input field. However, the input is only checked locally and not transmitted anywhere.
issues.location: createOverlay function, input field and button handler
issues.recommendation: Ensure that no future code changes add network requests or transmit user input externally.

issues.description: The script uses innerHTML to inject static HTML into the overlay. Since the content is static and not based on user input, the risk of DOM XSS is minimal.
issues.recommendation: If overlay content is ever made dynamic based on user input, sanitize input before insertion.

issues.description: The script requests no special permissions (@grant none) and does not use any privileged APIs.
issues.recommendation: Maintain minimal permissions for best security.

summary: This UserScript does not transmit data externally, does not collect sensitive information, and does not use privileged APIs. It creates a UI overlay for local access code entry, with no evidence of malicious or risky behavior. The only minor concern is user input collection, but it is handled locally. No supply chain, obfuscation, or XSS risks detected.
